summary: This regulation – (a) sets up regulatory requirements for banks’ investments in immovable properties, investments in shares of other companies, and in financial instruments legally accepted in Rwanda; and (b) sets mechanisms to minimize risks that banks are exposed to due to concentration risks inherent in excessive placements and deposits in other banks or financial institutions.
